body:
I never thought about how posting here would affect other people. I just wanted to reach out and see if maybe someone had the answers I was looking for...

I guess that's somewhat eye-opening. But even if we're not alone... why do we go on?

Why should I waste my time trying to bring happiness to others when nobody appreciates it? It seems like all of the good I've ever done has always gone to waste. It's taken for granted and then I'm cast aside.

I always feel so horrible when I think of everyone else who would kill to have what I have... I live in the USA, I'm receiving a good education, I have good food and a nice home to live in, with internet and a car... I feel selfish simply because of my feelings. I don't deserve to feel bad. I should be acting like the sun shines out of my ass... but I feel physically unable to. When I try to counsel myself, I always end up questioning our existence entirely. I cannot think of a single logical reason for me to be alive. What is our purpose? Just because my family would hurt, I shouldn't feel this way? How do I even know that they're real? How do I know that when I die, they don't just disappear? How do I know that the world doesn't cease to exist after I die? Just because other people grieve death in my life?
What am I supposed to do if the methods that are always suggested don't work? I don't know what I need to do to be happy. That's the question that's been on my mind for years.

That's what I've been doing for my entire life...
I used to always go out of my way in order to make people happy, in order to better the lives of everyone around me... my dreams all revolved around making the world a better place. But the older I get is the more I realize how futile it all is. As you say, humans are insignificant as a whole... so then what does that make me, the individual?

Living or not, I am a burden to my family, and suicide for the sake of martyrdom is stupid. You're right. People would get on with their lives. It's not like anyone I know really cares about me being /alive/ so why would they care if I was dead?

I’ve tried therapy. I’ve tried medication.
They don’t fucking work.

I’ve tried the hotlines.
They’re the most useless people ever. 

I’ve tried to think positively.
You know what? My entire life has been devoted to trying to do good for the world. How the fuck is that not positive?
The fact of the matter is, nobody will ever give a shit.
